subject: ela
intro: Determine multiple central ideas and summarize objectively.

items.prompt:
A complex informational text often carries:
A) two or more interacting central ideas
B) no ideas
C) only a title
items.answer: A) two or more interacting central ideas

solution.answer: A) two or more interacting central ideas

items.prompt:
An OBJECTIVE summary:
A) states key ideas without opinion
B) adds your judgment
C) is very long
items.answer: A) states key ideas without opinion

solution.answer: A) states key ideas without opinion

items.prompt:
Two central ideas in a text can:
A) interact and build on one another
B) never relate
C) only repeat the title
items.answer: A) interact and build on one another

solution.answer: A) interact and build on one another

items.prompt:
Read.

Mass tourism revived the island's economy but began to erode the beaches and culture that drew visitors.

Two central ideas are:
A) tourism's economic revival and its erosion of beaches/culture
B) only that islands are nice
C) only that beaches are sandy
items.answer: A) tourism's economic revival and its erosion of beaches/culture

steps: Two interacting ideas. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) tourism's economic revival and its erosion of beaches/culture

items.prompt:
Which is an OBJECTIVE summary of that passage?
A) Greedy tourists selfishly wrecked a beautiful paradise.
B) Mass tourism revived the economy but began to erode the beaches and culture that drew visitors.
C) I love islands.
items.answer: B) Mass tourism revived the economy but began to erode the beaches and culture that drew visitors.

solution.answer: B) Mass tourism revived the economy but began to erode the beaches and culture that drew visitors.

items.prompt:
When two central ideas INTERACT, they:
A) reinforce or complicate one another to build a complex analysis
B) cancel out
C) have no effect
items.answer: A) reinforce or complicate one another to build a complex analysis

solution.answer: A) reinforce or complicate one another to build a complex analysis

items.prompt:
Read.

The antibiotics that conquered deadly infections are, through overuse, breeding resistant superbugs that threaten to undo that very progress.

Two interacting central ideas are BEST stated as:
A) The triumph over infection and the threat that its overuse now poses to that triumph.
B) Medicine is hard.
C) Bacteria are small.
items.answer: A) The triumph over infection and the threat that its overuse now poses to that triumph.

steps: Two interacting ideas. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) The triumph over infection and the threat that its overuse now poses to that triumph.

items.prompt:
Which sentence does NOT belong in an objective summary of an article on automation?
A) Automation raised factory output.
B) Heartless companies obviously threw loyal workers away.
C) Automation displaced some skilled workers.
items.answer: B) Heartless companies obviously threw loyal workers away.

solution.answer: B) Heartless companies obviously threw loyal workers away.
